id-20260919-news-1.title: Prabowo Removes Purbaya from Minister of Finance Seat, Suahasil Nazara Officially Appointed to Replace

segments.src: Presiden Prabowo Subianto membuat kejutan di panggung politik nasional setelah resmi memberhentikan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa dari jabatan Menteri Keuangan.
segments.tr: President Prabowo Subianto made a surprise on the national political stage after officially dismissing Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa from the position of Minister of Finance.

segments.src: Sebagai penggantinya, Suahasil Nazara dilantik untuk mengisi kursi orang nomor satu di Kementerian Keuangan pada Senin (14/9/2026) di Istana Negara, Jakarta.
segments.tr: As his replacement, Suahasil Nazara was sworn in to fill the seat of the number one person in the Ministry of Finance on Monday (9/14/2026) at the State Palace, Jakarta.

segments.src: Dasar hukum pergantian ini tertuang dalam Keputusan Presiden (Keppres) Nomor 97/P Tahun 2026 tentang Pemberhentian dan Pengangkatan Menteri Keuangan Kabinet Merah Putih Sisa Masa Jabatan Periode 2024-2029.
segments.tr: The legal basis for this replacement is stated in Presidential Decree (Keppres) Number 97/P of 2026 concerning the Dismissal and Appointment of the Minister of Finance of the Red and White Cabinet for the Remainder of the 2024-2029 Term of Office.

segments.src: Pelantikan berlangsung dengan agenda yang relatif singkat, sebagaimana lazimnya prosesi pergantian pejabat setingkat menteri di lingkungan Istana.
segments.tr: The inauguration took place with a relatively brief agenda, as is customary for minister-level official replacement processions within the Palace environment.
## Serving Only About a Year

segments.src: Purbaya sebelumnya dilantik sebagai Menteri Keuangan pada 8 September 2025, menggantikan Sri Mulyani Indrawati yang telah menahkodai Kementerian Keuangan dalam waktu yang cukup lama.
segments.tr: Purbaya was previously inaugurated as Minister of Finance on September 8, 2025, replacing Sri Mulyani Indrawati who had steered the Ministry of Finance for quite a long time.

segments.src: Dengan pemberhentiannya pada pertengahan September 2026, praktis Purbaya hanya mengemban amanah tersebut selama kurang lebih satu tahun.
segments.tr: With his dismissal in mid-September 2026, practically Purbaya only held that mandate for approximately one year.

segments.src: Yang membuat publik terkejut, pergantian ini datang secara mendadak.
segments.tr: What made the public surprised, this replacement came suddenly.

segments.src: Beberapa jam sebelum pengumuman pemberhentiannya, Purbaya bahkan masih terlihat memimpin rapat kerja bersama Komite IV DPD, Kementerian PPN/Bappenas, dan Bank Indonesia di Kompleks Parlemen, memaparkan sejumlah program kerja Kementerian Keuangan seperti biasa.
segments.tr: A few hours before the announcement of his dismissal, Purbaya was even still seen leading a working meeting with DPD Committee IV, the Ministry of National Development Planning/Bappenas, and Bank Indonesia at the Parliamentary Complex, presenting a number of Ministry of Finance work programs as usual.

segments.src: Tidak ada tanda-tanda yang mengindikasikan akan terjadi pergantian pucuk pimpinan di kementerian tersebut pada hari itu.
segments.tr: There were no signs indicating that a change of top leadership would occur in the ministry on that day.

segments.src: ## Isu Rotasi Pejabat Pajak Ikut Mengemuka
segments.tr: ## Tax Official Rotation Issue Also Emerges

segments.src: Di tengah spekulasi publik mengenai alasan pemberhentiannya, nama Purbaya sempat dikaitkan dengan kebijakan rotasi besar-besaran terhadap sekitar 350 pejabat di lingkungan Direktorat Jenderal Pajak (DJP) yang ia teken tak lama sebelum lengser.
segments.tr: Amid public speculation regarding the reasons for his dismissal, Purbaya's name was linked to the massive rotation policy of around 350 officials within the Directorate General of Taxes (DJP) which he signed shortly before stepping down.

segments.src: Purbaya sendiri tidak menampik adanya keterkaitan antara kebijakan tersebut dengan momentum pemberhentiannya, meski ia enggan berspekulasi lebih jauh dan menegaskan bahwa pergantian menteri sepenuhnya merupakan hak prerogatif Presiden.
segments.tr: Purbaya himself did not deny the connection between that policy and the momentum of his dismissal, although he was reluctant to speculate further and emphasized that the replacement of ministers is entirely the prerogative of the President.

segments.src: Belakangan mencuat pula informasi bahwa sebagian rotasi pejabat pajak tersebut dinilai melompati tahapan penting seperti proses asesmen dan manajemen talenta internal, sehingga sempat diminta untuk ditinjau ulang oleh jajaran Direktorat Jenderal Pajak.
segments.tr: Lately, information also emerged that part of the tax official rotation was judged to have skipped important stages such as the assessment process and internal talent management, so it was asked to be reviewed by the Directorate General of Taxes ranks.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, pihak Istana melalui Wakil Menteri Sekretaris Negara Bambang Eko Suhariyanto membantah bila pemberhentian Purbaya semata-mata terkait dengan langkah rotasi pejabat pajak tersebut.
segments.tr: On the other hand, the Palace through Deputy Minister of State Secretary Bambang Eko Suhariyanto denied that Purbaya's dismissal was solely related to the tax official rotation step.

segments.src: Menurutnya, pergantian menteri adalah dinamika yang wajar dalam roda pemerintahan dan sepenuhnya menjadi kewenangan Presiden untuk melakukan evaluasi maupun penyegaran kabinet kapan pun diperlukan.
segments.tr: According to him, the replacement of ministers is a natural dynamic in the wheels of government and is entirely the authority of the President to conduct evaluations or cabinet refreshes whenever needed.
## Getting to Know Suahasil Nazara

segments.src: Suahasil Nazara bukan wajah baru di lingkungan Kementerian Keuangan.
segments.tr: Suahasil Nazara is not a new face within the Ministry of Finance.

segments.src: Pria kelahiran 23 November 1970 ini telah malang melintang sebagai Wakil Menteri Keuangan sejak tahun 2019, sehingga dinilai memahami betul seluk-beluk birokrasi dan kebijakan fiskal nasional.
segments.tr: The man born on November 23, 1970 has been active as Deputy Minister of Finance since 2019, so he is considered to truly understand the ins and outs of bureaucracy and national fiscal policy.

segments.src: Ia menempuh pendidikan sarjana ekonomi di Universitas Indonesia dan melanjutkan studi lanjutan di bidang ekonomi di luar negeri sebelum meniti karier panjang di jalur kebijakan publik dan keuangan negara.
segments.tr: He pursued his bachelor's degree in economics at the University of Indonesia and continued advanced studies in economics abroad before embarking on a long career in the path of public policy and state finance.

segments.src: Dengan rekam jejak tersebut, penunjukan Suahasil dipandang sejumlah kalangan sebagai langkah untuk menjaga kesinambungan kebijakan fiskal di tengah situasi ekonomi global yang masih penuh tantangan, sekaligus meminimalkan masa transisi yang biasanya dibutuhkan pejabat baru untuk beradaptasi.
segments.tr: With that track record, Suahasil's appointment is viewed by a number of circles as a step to maintain the continuity of fiscal policy amid a global economic situation that is still full of challenges, while minimizing the transition period usually needed by new officials to adapt.
## Heavy Tasks Await the New Minister of Finance

segments.src: Begitu resmi menjabat, Suahasil langsung dihadapkan pada sejumlah pekerjaan rumah, salah satunya menyikapi polemik rotasi pejabat di Direktorat Jenderal Pajak dan Direktorat Jenderal Bea dan Cukai yang sempat dirombak pada masa kepemimpinan Purbaya.
segments.tr: Once officially serving, Suahasil was immediately faced with a number of homework assignments, one of which is addressing the polemic of official rotation in the Directorate General of Taxes and the Directorate General of Customs and Excise which was reshuffled during Purbaya's leadership.

segments.src: Publik juga menanti arah kebijakan fiskal, target penerimaan negara, serta strategi menjaga stabilitas anggaran menjelang tutup tahun 2026.
segments.tr: The public is also awaiting the direction of fiscal policy, state revenue targets, and strategies to maintain budget stability ahead of the end of the year 2026.

segments.src: Pergantian menteri keuangan dalam waktu relatif singkat ini turut menjadi perbincangan hangat di kalangan warganet dan pengamat ekonomi, yang menyoroti dinamika di internal Kabinet Merah Putih.
segments.tr: The replacement of the minister of finance in a relatively short time has also become a hot topic of conversation among netizens and economic observers, who highlight the dynamics within the Red and White Cabinet.

segments.src: Namun demikian, pihak Istana menegaskan bahwa proses pemerintahan tetap berjalan normal dan seluruh program prioritas di sektor keuangan negara akan terus dilanjutkan di bawah kepemimpinan menteri yang baru.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, the Palace emphasized that the government process continues to run normally and all priority programs in the state financial sector will continue to be carried out under the leadership of the new minister.

id-20260919-news-3.title: Prabowo and Zulhas Launch National Cheap PANsar, Staple Foods Discounted up to 60 Percent for 2 Million Citizens

segments.src: ## Program Sembako Murah Diluncurkan di Puncak HUT Ke-28 PAN
segments.tr: ## Cheap Staple Food Program Launched at PAN's 28th Anniversary Peak

segments.src: Presiden Prabowo Subianto bersama Ketua Umum Partai Amanat Nasional (PAN) sekaligus Menteri Koordinator Bidang Pangan, Zulkifli Hasan atau yang akrab disapa Zulhas, meluncurkan program bertajuk **PANsar Murah Nasional**.
segments.tr: President Prabowo Subianto, together with the General Chairperson of the National Mandate Party (PAN) and Coordinating Minister for Food, Zulkifli Hasan, familiarly known as Zulhas, launched a program titled **PANsar Murah Nasional**.

segments.src: Peluncuran ini dilakukan bertepatan dengan puncak peringatan Hari Ulang Tahun ke-28 PAN, dan menjadi salah satu sorotan utama dalam rangkaian acara tersebut.
segments.tr: This launch coincided with the peak commemoration of PAN's 28th anniversary, becoming one of the main highlights in the event series.

segments.src: Program ini dirancang sebagai bentuk bantuan langsung kepada masyarakat berupa penyediaan kebutuhan pokok dengan harga yang jauh lebih murah dari harga pasaran.
segments.tr: This program is designed as a form of direct assistance to the community in the form of providing basic necessities at prices much cheaper than market prices.

segments.src: ## Diskon hingga 60 Persen lewat Sistem Kupon
segments.tr: ## Discounts up to 60 Percent via Coupon System

segments.src: Berdasarkan keterangan panitia penyelenggara, PANsar Murah Nasional menyasar sekitar **2 juta warga** di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: Based on information from the organizing committee, the National Cheap PANsar targets around **2 million citizens** in various regions.

segments.src: Komoditas yang menjadi fokus program ini meliputi:
segments.tr: The commodities that are the focus of this program include:
- Rice
- Cooking oil
- Eggs
- Sugar

segments.src: Keempat komoditas tersebut ditawarkan dengan potongan harga berkisar **50 hingga 60 persen** dari harga normal.
segments.tr: These four commodities are offered with price cuts ranging from **50 to 60 percent** of the normal price.

segments.src: Untuk mendapatkan sembako murah ini, warga perlu menukarkan **kupon** yang telah dibagikan melalui jaringan struktur partai di tingkat daerah.
segments.tr: To get these cheap staple foods, residents need to exchange **coupons** that have been distributed through the party's structural network at the regional level.

segments.src: Skema kupon ini diklaim bertujuan agar penyaluran bantuan lebih tepat sasaran dan terdata dengan baik.
segments.tr: This coupon scheme is claimed to aim at making aid distribution more targeted and well-recorded.
## Price Difference Borne by the Party

segments.src: Salah satu hal yang menjadi perhatian publik dari program ini adalah sumber pembiayaannya.
segments.tr: One of the things that attracted public attention from this program is its funding source.

segments.src: Pihak penyelenggara menyebutkan bahwa **selisih antara harga pasar dan harga diskon ditanggung oleh partai**, bukan berasal dari anggaran negara.
segments.tr: The organizers stated that **the difference between the market price and the discounted price is borne by the party**, not originating from the state budget.

segments.src: Dengan kata lain, program ini diposisikan sebagai inisiatif internal partai dalam rangka perayaan hari jadinya, sekaligus sebagai bentuk kepedulian terhadap daya beli masyarakat di tengah dinamika harga kebutuhan pokok belakangan ini.
segments.tr: In other words, this program is positioned as an internal party initiative in the context of celebrating its anniversary, as well as a form of concern for people's purchasing power amid recent price dynamics of basic necessities.

segments.src: Zulhas dalam kapasitasnya sebagai Ketua Umum PAN menyampaikan bahwa kegiatan ini merupakan wujud komitmen partai untuk hadir langsung di tengah masyarakat, terutama menjelang momentum-momentum yang biasanya diikuti kenaikan harga bahan pokok.
segments.tr: Zulhas in his capacity as the General Chairperson of PAN expressed that this activity is a manifestation of the party's commitment to be directly present among the community, especially ahead of moments usually followed by price hikes of basic goods.
## Community Response and Expectations

segments.src: Peluncuran program ini disambut antusias oleh sejumlah warga yang hadir dalam acara puncak HUT PAN.
segments.tr: The launch of this program was greeted with enthusiasm by a number of residents who attended PAN's peak anniversary event.

segments.src: Banyak yang berharap program semacam ini dapat berlanjut secara berkala, mengingat manfaatnya yang dirasakan langsung oleh masyarakat menengah ke bawah.
segments.tr: Many hope that such programs can continue periodically, considering the benefits are felt directly by the lower-middle class society.

segments.src: Meski demikian, sejumlah pengamat mengingatkan pentingnya transparansi dalam pendataan penerima manfaat serta mekanisme distribusi kupon, agar bantuan benar-benar tepat sasaran dan tidak menimbulkan kerumunan atau potensi penyalahgunaan di lapangan.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, a number of observers reminded the importance of transparency in data collection of beneficiaries and the coupon distribution mechanism, so that aid is truly targeted and does not cause crowds or potential misuse in the field.
## Conclusion

segments.src: PANsar Murah Nasional menjadi salah satu program bantuan pangan berskala besar yang diinisiasi oleh partai politik menjelang akhir tahun 2026.
segments.tr: The National Cheap PANsar is one of the large-scale food assistance programs initiated by political parties towards the end of 2026.

segments.src: Dengan target 2 juta warga penerima manfaat dan skema pembiayaan yang ditanggung internal partai, program ini menambah daftar upaya berbagai pihak dalam menjaga stabilitas daya beli masyarakat di tengah tantangan ekonomi yang masih dihadapi banyak keluarga Indonesia saat ini.
segments.tr: With a target of 2 million beneficiary citizens and a funding scheme borne internally by the party, this program adds to the list of efforts by various parties in maintaining the stability of people's purchasing power amidst the economic challenges still faced by many Indonesian families today.

id-20260919-news-2.title: Fuel Scarcity Paralyzes South Sulawesi, Online Schooling and WFH Implemented in Makassar to Jember

segments.src: Kelangkaan bahan bakar minyak (BBM) bersubsidi yang terjadi dalam beberapa hari terakhir dilaporkan berdampak luas terhadap aktivitas masyarakat di sejumlah wilayah, termasuk Makassar, Maros, dan Jember.
segments.tr: The scarcity of subsidized fuel (BBM) that has occurred in the last few days is reported to have had a widespread impact on community activities in a number of regions, including Makassar, Maros, and Jember.

segments.src: Antrean panjang kendaraan di berbagai stasiun pengisian bahan bakar umum (SPBU) membuat sejumlah pemerintah daerah mengambil langkah darurat, mulai dari pemberlakuan sekolah daring hingga kebijakan bekerja dari rumah (work from home/WFH) bagi aparatur sipil negara (ASN).
segments.tr: Long queues of vehicles at various public fuel filling stations (SPBU) have caused a number of local governments to take emergency measures, ranging from the implementation of online schooling to work-from-home (WFH) policies for state civil apparatus (ASN).
## Queues Snake, Residents' Activities Disrupted

segments.src: Berdasarkan sejumlah laporan media lokal dan unggahan warganet, antrean kendaraan bermotor maupun mobil di berbagai SPBU di kawasan Sulawesi Selatan dilaporkan mengular hingga ratusan meter dan berlangsung selama berjam-jam.
segments.tr: Based on a number of local media reports and netizen posts, queues of motorcycles and cars at various SPBUs in the South Sulawesi region are reported to be snaking for hundreds of meters and lasting for hours.

segments.src: Kondisi ini disebut-sebut mulai terjadi sejak beberapa hari terakhir dan belum sepenuhnya teratasi hingga berita ini disusun.
segments.tr: This condition is said to have started occurring in the last few days and has not been fully resolved as of the time this news was compiled.

segments.src: Warga mengeluhkan sulitnya mendapatkan BBM jenis subsidi untuk keperluan sehari-hari, termasuk untuk berangkat kerja maupun mengantar anak sekolah.
segments.tr: Residents have complained about the difficulty of obtaining subsidized fuel for daily needs, including for going to work and taking children to school.

segments.src: Situasi ini turut memicu kekhawatiran akan terganggunya aktivitas ekonomi dan pelayanan publik di daerah terdampak.
segments.tr: This situation has also sparked concerns about the disruption of economic activities and public services in the affected areas.

segments.src: ## Sekolah Daring dan WFH Sebagai Langkah Antisipasi
segments.tr: ## Online Schooling and WFH as Anticipatory Measures

segments.src: Untuk mengurangi risiko keterlambatan maupun kesulitan mobilitas akibat minimnya pasokan bahan bakar, sejumlah pemerintah daerah dilaporkan mengambil kebijakan sementara berupa pembelajaran jarak jauh (daring) bagi sekolah-sekolah di wilayah terdampak, termasuk di Makassar dan Jember.
segments.tr: To reduce the risk of delays and mobility difficulties due to the lack of fuel supply, a number of local governments are reported to have taken temporary policies in the form of distance learning (online) for schools in the affected areas, including in Makassar and Jember.

segments.src: Selain itu, sebagian instansi pemerintah juga disebut memberlakukan sistem kerja dari rumah bagi ASN guna menekan volume kendaraan yang membutuhkan BBM untuk mobilitas harian.
segments.tr: In addition, some government agencies are also said to be implementing a work-from-home system for ASN to reduce the volume of vehicles that require fuel for daily mobility.

segments.src: Kebijakan tersebut disebut bersifat sementara dan akan dievaluasi kembali seiring perkembangan pasokan BBM di masing-masing daerah.
segments.tr: The policy is said to be temporary and will be re-evaluated in line with developments in fuel supply in each region.

segments.src: Masyarakat diimbau untuk memantau informasi resmi dari pemerintah daerah maupun sekolah setempat terkait kelanjutan kebijakan ini.
segments.tr: The public is advised to monitor official information from local governments and local schools regarding the continuation of this policy.
## SPBU Implement Odd-Even System

segments.src: Guna mengurai kepadatan antrean sekaligus memastikan distribusi yang lebih merata, sejumlah SPBU di wilayah terdampak dilaporkan menerapkan sistem ganjil-genap berdasarkan nomor polisi kendaraan.
segments.tr: To unravel queue congestion while ensuring more even distribution, a number of SPBUs in the affected areas are reported to be implementing an odd-even system based on vehicle license plate numbers.

segments.src: Dengan mekanisme ini, kendaraan dengan nomor polisi ganjil dan genap dijadwalkan mengisi BBM pada hari yang berbeda, dengan harapan dapat mengurangi penumpukan kendaraan dalam satu waktu.
segments.tr: With this mechanism, vehicles with odd and even license plate numbers are scheduled to fill up on fuel on different days, with the hope of reducing vehicle buildup at one time.

segments.src: Pihak berwenang setempat disebut terus melakukan koordinasi dengan penyalur BBM untuk mempercepat proses distribusi ke wilayah-wilayah yang mengalami kelangkaan, termasuk memantau kelancaran pasokan dari depo maupun terminal BBM terdekat.
segments.tr: Local authorities are said to continue to coordinate with fuel distributors to accelerate the distribution process to areas experiencing scarcity, including monitoring the smooth supply from the nearest fuel depots or terminals.
## Impact on Economic Activities

segments.src: Kelangkaan BBM turut dirasakan oleh pelaku usaha, khususnya di sektor transportasi dan logistik.
segments.tr: The fuel scarcity is also being felt by business actors, especially in the transportation and logistics sectors.

segments.src: Sejumlah pengemudi ojek daring, angkutan umum, hingga pelaku usaha kecil mengaku terpaksa mengurangi jam operasional akibat kesulitan mendapatkan bahan bakar.
segments.tr: A number of online motorcycle taxi drivers, public transportation drivers, and small business owners admitted that they were forced to reduce operating hours due to difficulties in obtaining fuel.

segments.src: Kondisi ini dikhawatirkan dapat berdampak pada aktivitas ekonomi harian masyarakat apabila tidak segera diatasi.
segments.tr: This condition is feared to have an impact on the daily economic activities of the community if it is not resolved immediately.
## Appeal to the Public

segments.src: Menyikapi situasi ini, warga diimbau untuk tidak melakukan pembelian BBM secara berlebihan atau menimbun stok pribadi, karena dikhawatirkan dapat memperparah kelangkaan yang ada.
segments.tr: Responding to this situation, residents are advised not to make excessive fuel purchases or hoard personal stocks, as it is feared that it could worsen the existing scarcity.

segments.src: Masyarakat juga diminta untuk mengikuti arahan dan jadwal yang telah ditetapkan oleh masing-masing SPBU maupun instansi terkait.
segments.tr: The public is also asked to follow the directions and schedules that have been set by each SPBU and related agencies.

segments.src: Hingga saat ini, pemantauan terhadap perkembangan situasi di lapangan masih terus dilakukan.
segments.tr: Until now, monitoring of the situation on the ground is still being carried out.

segments.src: Masyarakat diharapkan tetap mengacu pada informasi resmi dari pemerintah daerah dan instansi berwenang untuk mendapatkan kabar terbaru seputar penanganan kelangkaan BBM di wilayah masing-masing.
segments.tr: The public is expected to continue to refer to official information from local governments and authorized agencies to get the latest news regarding the handling of fuel scarcity in their respective regions.

id-20260919-intro-retail-1.title: [Retail #1] Why Can the Price of Coffee at a Local Shop Be Different from the Factory Price?

segments.src: > Distribusi adalah rangkaian kegiatan yang memindahkan barang dari produsen ke konsumen — dan "perantara" yang sering dianggap cuma menaikkan harga sebenarnya sedang menjual empat hal: tempat, waktu, jumlah, dan kepemilikan.
segments.tr: > Distribution is a series of activities that move goods from producers to consumers — and "intermediaries" that are often considered to only increase prices are actually selling four things: place, time, quantity, and possession.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini — Apa Itu Distribusi?
segments.tr: ## Concept of the Day — What Is Distribution?

segments.src: Bayangkan sebuah pabrik mi instan di Karawang memproduksi 2 juta bungkus per hari.
segments.tr: Imagine an instant noodle factory in Karawang producing 2 million packs per day.

segments.src: Sementara itu, Anda hanya ingin membeli 5 bungkus, malam ini, di warung 200 meter dari rumah.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, you only want to buy 5 packs, tonight, at a shop 200 meters from home.

segments.src: Ada jurang besar di antara keduanya:
segments.tr: There is a huge gap between the two:

segments.src: - **Jurang tempat**: pabrik di Karawang, Anda di Makassar.
segments.tr: - **Place gap**: factory in Karawang, you in Makassar.

segments.src: - **Jurang waktu**: pabrik produksi pagi hari, Anda butuh jam 10 malam.
segments.tr: - **Time gap**: factory produces in the morning, you need it at 10 PM.

segments.src: - **Jurang jumlah**: pabrik menjual per truk, Anda beli per bungkus.
segments.tr: - **Quantity gap**: factory sells by the truckload, you buy by the pack.

segments.src: - **Jurang informasi**: pabrik tidak tahu Anda ada; Anda tidak tahu nomor telepon pabrik.
segments.tr: - **Information gap**: factory doesn't know you exist; you don't know the factory's phone number.

segments.src: **Distribusi (distribusi/saluran pemasaran)** adalah seluruh rangkaian aktivitas dan lembaga yang menjembatani jurang-jurang tadi.
segments.tr: **Distribution (distribution/marketing channel)** is the entire series of activities and institutions that bridge those gaps.

segments.src: Dalam bahasa akademik: *proses mengalirkan produk dan jasa dari titik produksi ke titik konsumsi, beserta aliran informasi, pembayaran, dan kepemilikan yang menyertainya.*
segments.tr: In academic terms: *the process of moving products and services from the point of production to the point of consumption, along with the accompanying flow of information, payment, and ownership.*
### Intermediaries: parasites or problem solvers?

segments.src: Keluhan klasik: "Kalau tanpa tengkulak, harga cabai pasti lebih murah."
segments.tr: Classic complaint: "If it weren't for middlemen, the price of chili would definitely be cheaper."

segments.src: Kritik ini tidak sepenuhnya salah — rantai yang terlalu panjang atau tidak kompetitif memang menambah biaya.
segments.tr: This criticism is not entirely wrong — a chain that is too long or uncompetitive does indeed add costs.

segments.src: Tapi menghapus perantara tidak menghapus pekerjaannya; pekerjaan itu hanya berpindah tangan.
segments.tr: But removing intermediaries does not remove the work; that work just changes hands.

segments.src: Ada satu argumen klasik yang menjelaskannya: **prinsip pengurangan jumlah transaksi**.
segments.tr: There is one classic argument that explains it: the **principle of transaction reduction**.
Suppose there are 5 producers and 5 retailers.

segments.src: Kalau setiap produsen harus berhubungan langsung dengan setiap pengecer:
segments.tr: If every producer had to deal directly with every retailer:
Tanpa perantara : 5 x 5 = 25 jalur transaksi
Dengan 1 grosir : 5 + 5 = 10 jalur transaksi
From 25 down to 10.

segments.src: Setiap jalur itu berarti biaya nyata: ongkos kirim, negosiasi, faktur, penagihan, risiko gagal bayar.
segments.tr: Every path means real costs: shipping fees, negotiation, invoicing, billing, risk of default.
Intermediaries "sell" that savings.

segments.src: Margin yang ia ambil adalah bayaran atas fungsi tersebut — wajar bila fungsinya nyata, dan mahal bila ia hanya menumpang di tengah tanpa menambah nilai.
segments.tr: The margin they take is payment for that function — it's reasonable if the function is real, and expensive if they are just hitching a ride in the middle without adding value.
### Main functions of distribution channels

segments.src: Sebuah saluran distribusi umumnya menjalankan fungsi-fungsi berikut:
segments.tr: A distribution channel generally performs the following functions:

segments.src: 1. **Fungsi transaksi** — mencari pembeli, menegosiasikan harga, memindahkan hak milik.
segments.tr: 1. **Transaction function** — finding buyers, negotiating prices, transferring ownership.

segments.src: 2. **Fungsi logistik** — mengangkut, menyimpan, memilah dan mengemas ulang.
segments.tr: 2. **Logistics function** — transporting, storing, sorting, and repackaging.

segments.src: 3. **Fungsi fasilitasi** — menanggung risiko (barang rusak, tidak laku), menyediakan pembiayaan (kasbon/tempo), mengumpulkan informasi pasar.
segments.tr: 3. **Facilitation function** — bearing risk (damaged goods, unsold items), providing financing (credit/terms), collecting market information.

segments.src: Fungsi-fungsi ini **bisa dipindahkan, tapi tidak bisa dihilangkan**.
segments.tr: These functions **can be transferred, but cannot be eliminated**.

segments.src: Ketika sebuah brand menjual langsung lewat e-commerce (D2C), gudangnya sendiri yang menyimpan stok, kurirnya sendiri yang mengantar, dan ia sendiri yang menanggung retur.
segments.tr: When a brand sells directly via e-commerce (D2C), its own warehouse stores the stock, its own courier delivers it, and it bears the returns itself.

segments.src: Biayanya tidak lenyap — hanya pindah ke pos yang berbeda.
segments.tr: The costs don't disappear — they just move to a different account.
### Four utilities created by distribution

segments.src: Inilah jawaban atas pertanyaan "sebenarnya perantara menjual apa?"
segments.tr: This is the answer to the question "what are intermediaries actually selling?"
| Utility | Content | Example |

segments.src: | **Utilitas tempat** | mendekatkan barang ke konsumen | air mineral tersedia di puncak Bromo |
segments.tr: | **Place utility** | bringing goods closer to consumers | mineral water available at the peak of Bromo |

segments.src: | **Utilitas waktu** | menyediakan saat dibutuhkan | Indomaret 24 jam saat butuh popok jam 2 pagi |
segments.tr: | **Time utility** | providing when needed | 24-hour Indomaret when you need diapers at 2 AM |

segments.src: | **Utilitas bentuk/jumlah** | memecah ukuran besar jadi eceran | beras karungan dijual per liter di toko kelontong |
segments.tr: | **Form/quantity utility** | breaking down large sizes into retail | rice in sacks sold by the liter at grocery stores |

segments.src: | **Utilitas kepemilikan** | memudahkan perpindahan hak milik | cicilan 0%, QRIS, bayar di tempat (COD) |
segments.tr: | **Possession utility** | facilitating transfer of ownership | 0% installments, QRIS, cash on delivery (COD) |

segments.src: Sebotol air mineral yang di pabrik seharga Rp1.500 bisa jadi Rp10.000 di kios puncak gunung.
segments.tr: A bottle of mineral water that costs Rp1.500 at the factory can become Rp10.000 at a mountain peak kiosk.

segments.src: Selisih Rp8.500 itu bukan sekadar "markup" — itu harga dari utilitas tempat dan waktu yang tidak bisa Anda hasilkan sendiri kecuali dengan memanggul sendiri sebotol air ke atas gunung.
segments.tr: The difference of Rp8.500 is not just a "markup" — it is the price of place and time utility that you cannot produce yourself unless you carry a bottle of water up the mountain yourself.
## In Daily Life

segments.src: Ambil contoh **cabai rawit merah** — komoditas yang harganya rutin jadi berita.
segments.tr: Take the example of **red bird's eye chili** — a commodity whose price is regularly in the news.

segments.src: Alurnya kira-kira begini: petani di Brebes menjual ke pengepul desa, pengepul menjual ke pedagang besar di Pasar Induk Kramat Jati, lalu ke pedagang pasar tradisional atau distributor supermarket, baru sampai ke Anda di Jakarta.
segments.tr: The flow is roughly like this: farmers in Brebes sell to village collectors, collectors sell to wholesalers at the Kramat Jati Central Market, then to traditional market traders or supermarket distributors, before finally reaching you in Jakarta.

segments.src: Petani mungkin menerima Rp25.000/kg saat harga di pasar Rp60.000/kg.
segments.tr: Farmers might receive Rp25.000/kg when the market price is Rp60.000/kg.
Sounds unfair.

segments.src: Tapi mari lihat apa yang terjadi di antara keduanya:
segments.tr: But let's look at what happens between the two:

segments.src: - **Pengepul** datang ke kebun, membeli tunai di hari panen — petani tidak perlu menyewa truk atau mencari pembeli. Ini utilitas tempat + kepemilikan.
segments.tr: - **Collectors** come to the farm, buy in cash on harvest day — farmers don't need to rent trucks or find buyers. This is place + possession utility.

segments.src: - **Pedagang besar** menanggung risiko susut: cabai busuk 10–20% dalam perjalanan, dan kerugian itu ditanggung dia, bukan petani.
segments.tr: - **Wholesalers** bear the risk of shrinkage: 10–20% of chilies rot during transit, and that loss is borne by them, not the farmer.

segments.src: - **Pedagang pasar** memecah karung 50 kg menjadi ikatan Rp5.000 — utilitas jumlah, karena Anda tidak butuh 50 kg cabai.
segments.tr: - **Market traders** break down 50 kg sacks into Rp5.000 bundles — quantity utility, because you don't need 50 kg of chili.

segments.src: - **Ongkos transportasi** Brebes–Jakarta, retribusi pasar, sewa lapak, dan modal kerja semua melekat di angka itu.
segments.tr: - **Transportation costs** from Brebes to Jakarta, market levies, stall rent, and working capital are all attached to that figure.

segments.src: Karena itu program seperti **Toko Tani Indonesia** atau aplikasi *farm-to-table* memang bisa memangkas selisih harga — tapi hanya kalau mereka benar-benar mengambil alih fungsi logistik dan risikonya.
segments.tr: That's why programs like **Toko Tani Indonesia** or *farm-to-table* apps can indeed cut price differences — but only if they truly take over the logistics and risk functions.

segments.src: Kalau tidak, yang terjadi cuma perantara lama diganti perantara baru berbaju aplikasi.
segments.tr: If not, what happens is just the old intermediary being replaced by a new intermediary wearing an app disguise.

segments.src: Sisi lain: ketika Anda memesan kopi lewat GoFood dan membayar ongkir Rp12.000 untuk kopi Rp25.000, Anda sedang secara sadar membeli utilitas tempat dan waktu.
segments.tr: On the other hand: when you order coffee via GoFood and pay a delivery fee of Rp12.000 for a Rp25.000 coffee, you are consciously buying place and time utility.

segments.src: Sama persis logikanya dengan tengkulak cabai — hanya lebih terlihat karena biayanya dirinci di layar.
segments.tr: The logic is exactly the same as the chili middleman — just more visible because the costs are detailed on the screen.
## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. **Distribusi** adalah rangkaian kegiatan yang menjembatani jurang tempat, waktu, jumlah, dan informasi antara produsen dan konsumen.
segments.tr: 1. **Distribution** is a series of activities that bridge the gaps in place, time, quantity, and information between producers and consumers.

segments.src: 2. **Perantara** menekan total biaya transaksi (5x5=25 menjadi 5+5=10 jalur); fungsinya bisa dipindahkan tapi tidak bisa dihapus.
segments.tr: 2. **Intermediaries** reduce total transaction costs (5x5=25 becomes 5+5=10 paths); their functions can be transferred but cannot be deleted.

segments.src: 3. Nilai yang diciptakan distribusi berwujud **empat utilitas**: tempat, waktu, bentuk/jumlah, dan kepemilikan.
segments.tr: 3. The value created by distribution takes the form of **four utilities**: place, time, form/quantity, and possession.

## 📚 Terms of the Day

segments.src: - **Saluran distribusi (distribution channel)** — rangkaian lembaga yang dilalui produk dari produsen hingga konsumen akhir.
segments.tr: - **Distribution channel** — a series of institutions through which a product passes from producer to final consumer.

segments.src: - **Perantara (intermediary/middleman)** — pihak yang berdiri di antara produsen dan konsumen sambil menjalankan fungsi transaksi, logistik, atau fasilitasi.
segments.tr: - **Intermediary/middleman** — a party that stands between producers and consumers while performing transaction, logistics, or facilitation functions.

segments.src: - **Prinsip pengurangan jumlah transaksi** — gagasan bahwa kehadiran perantara menurunkan total jalur kontak yang dibutuhkan, sehingga menekan biaya sistem secara keseluruhan.
segments.tr: - **Principle of transaction reduction** — the idea that the presence of intermediaries reduces the total number of contact paths required, thereby reducing overall system costs.

segments.src: - **Utilitas (utility)** — nilai guna tambahan yang dirasakan konsumen; dalam distribusi terdiri atas utilitas tempat, waktu, bentuk/jumlah, dan kepemilikan.
segments.tr: - **Utility** — additional use value perceived by consumers; in distribution, it consists of place, time, form/quantity, and possession utility.

segments.src: - **D2C (direct-to-consumer)** — model penjualan langsung dari produsen ke konsumen tanpa perantara independen; fungsi distribusi tetap ada, hanya diambil alih sendiri.
segments.tr: - **D2C (direct-to-consumer)** — a sales model directly from producer to consumer without independent intermediaries; distribution functions remain, they are just taken over by the producer itself.
Without intermediaries: 6 x 4 = 24 paths.
With one wholesaler: 6 + 4 = 10 paths.

segments.src: Semakin banyak pihak di kedua sisi, semakin besar penghematannya.
segments.tr: The more parties on both sides, the greater the savings.
**2 — (B)** Form/quantity utility.

segments.tr: Household consumers do not need 25 kg at once; breaking down large sizes into retail is one of the core functions of retailers.

segments.tr: Distribution functions can change hands, but cannot be eliminated.

segments.tr: In the D2C model, the brand itself must rent a warehouse, arrange shipping, and bear returns — the costs move to a different account, they don't disappear.*
